in_sanskrit.name: Rāmāvatār
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The manifestation or descent of Rama, an avatar of the god Vishnu

in_marathi.name: Ramavatar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Name, Rama's Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramavatar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ramavatar translates to 'Rama's Protector' in Sanskrit and Hindi. 'Rama' refers to the popular Hindu deity, Lord Rama, who embodies the ideals of righteousness, duty, and love. 'Vatar' means protector or guardian. This name is often given to a boy as a symbol of strength, courage, and divine protection.
